## Margoyle (CR 5)

**XP** 1,600  
 CE Medium monstrous humanoid (earth)  

**Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +10  

**Defense**

 **AC** 18, touch 12, flat-footed 16 (+2 Dex, +6 natural)  

**hp** 90 (6d10+24 plus 6)  

**Fort** +6; **Ref** +7; **Will** +6  

**DR** 10/magic  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft., fly 60 ft. (average)  

**Melee** 2 claws +10 (1d6+3), bite +9 (1d6+3), gore +9 (1d6+3)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 17, **Dex** 15, **Con** 19, **Int** 8, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 8  

**Base Atk** +6; **CMB** +9; **CMD** 21  

**Feats** Skill Focus (Fly), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), [Weapon Focus (claw)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (claw).*  

**Skills** Fly +14, Perception +10, Stealth +10 (+16 stony environs), Survival +7; **Racial Modifiers** +2 Perception, +2 Stealth (+8 Stealth in stony environs)  

**Languages** Common, Terran  

**SQ** freeze  

**Special Abilities**

 **Freeze (Ex)** A margoyle can hold itself so still it appears to be a statue. A margoyle that uses freeze can take 20 on its Stealth check to hide in plain sight as a stone statue.  
 


**Ecology**

 
 **Environment** any land, aquatic, and underground  

**Organization** solitary, pair, or wing (1–2 margoyles and 4–6 gargoyles)  

**Treasure** standard
